senses.gloss: m. (רְעֵי II) will, pleasure (corresp. to h. רָצוֹן, חפֶץ &c.).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 33:24">Targ. O. ib. 24</cite> (h. text <cite ref="T00975"><he>רצוי</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 1:3">Targ. Lev. I, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 1:9">9</cite> (O. ed. Berl. <cite ref="T00884"><he>רָעַוָּא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 13:23">Targ. Jud. XIII, 23</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="T00884"><he>רַעֲוָא</he></cite> f., constr. <he>רַעֲוַת</he>, <he>רַעֲוַות</he>, v. <cite ref="T00888"><he>רְעוּתָא</he></cite>.]—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:2:3">Koh. R. to III, 2</cite> <he>יהא ר׳ מקמיה וכ׳</he> may it be the pleasure of the Holy One &c.
<cite ref="Niddah 33b:46">Nidd. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>יהא ר׳ דתהוי וכ׳</he> may it be the will (of God) that thou be like him.
<cite ref="Beitzah 38a:9">Bets. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>יהא ר׳ דאימא וכ׳</he> may it please God, that I say something acceptable; a. fr.
